study: S14 (reading of the S13 single-seed screen) → S15 (replication of the one arm that passed, Y3, and its dissection)
repo_commit: aed5257 (the S13 code every S13 cell ran on). The S14 analysis, its evidence and this file are uncommitted when it is frozen. S15 needs a runner change only (per-cell seeds; see implementation) — no model or training code.

S12.role: parent design of Y1–Y4: regime R1, the reference, H21a/H21b and their decision rule are taken from it unchanged

S13.role: the single-seed amendment (D28). Its 'replication' clause is executed here for the one arm whose verdict was 'pass' (Y3)

motivating_evidence: S14 findings F73–F81 (evidence/S14_screen_reading/). Every S13 held-out row was scored once by its own cell's final evaluation (Y1's fused cells with a calib-chosen weight) and aggregated in S14; nothing was tuned on it. Y3 passed H21a/H21b and, beyond its frozen hypotheses, scored above every X1 run in all three of its cells (F74). The new hypotheses H21c–H21e and the dissection H22a/H22b are MOTIVATED BY THOSE SEED-0 RESULTS; to limit the winner's curse, H21c–H21e are read on the fresh seeds (1, 2) only — the seed-0 cells that motivated them do not enter them. H21a/H21b are the parent's and are read on seeds 0–2 exactly as the parent froze them.

regime.name: R1 (unchanged; read from preregistration_s12.json → regime.overrides)
regime.overrides: single.mixup_epochs=30 single.arcface_m=0.0 single.margin_warmup_start=31 single.margin_warmup_end=31 grad_clip=50.0 single.epochs=200 single.patience=40

reference.parent: preregistration_s12.json → reference (X1, commit 413a11e): grouped 0.530786 (sd 0.009933), same 0.648493, cross 0.146637 (sd 0.009823), attraction 0.463958 (sd 0.020362), stratified 0.726984 (sd 0.005806); margins 2·max(sd, 0.009)
reference.fresh_seed_reference: X1 cells at the same folds and seeds as the fresh Y3 cells (evidence/S12_frozen_arms_reading/cells.csv): grouped seeds 1–2, folds 0–1 (4 runs) F1 0.528496, cross 0.145363, attraction 0.467445; stratified seeds 1–2 (2 runs) F1 0.728593
reference.dissection_reference: X1 grouped seed 0 (f0 0.535325, f1 0.535409) and Y3 grouped seed 0 (f0 0.564614, f1 0.558945); evidence/S14_screen_reading/cells.csv

metric: as the parent: macro-F1 on val ∪ test, TTA, mean over runs (no-TTA beside); same/cross-session macro-recall and cross-session attraction from reporting/session.py; checkpoint chosen on calib only; every held-out kernel scored once. Differences of means carry a hierarchical bootstrap CI (2,000 resamples: runs within fold, held-out kernels within fold shared by both arms), as S12 hypotheses.py.

Y3_replication.change: None. The S13 arm Y3 exactly (model.spectral_descriptor=snv_morph model.spatial_tail_strides=[2,2,2,1] model.cbam_min_hw=3, R1) at seeds 1 and 2.
Y3_replication.runs: grouped folds 0,1 × seeds 1,2 (4) + stratified seeds 1,2 (2) = 6 runs; with S13's seed-0 cells the parent's 9-run design

Y5_dissection.change: Y3's three removals split in two, each alone on the shipped architecture, R1: Y5 desc_only = model.spectral_descriptor=snv_morph (tail [2,2,2,2], every CBAM); Y5 spatial_repair = model.spatial_tail_strides=[2,2,2,1] model.cbam_min_hw=3 (full descriptor). The CBAM removal goes with the tail because both concern the 2 × 2 map (S10 B8, F48); cbam_min_hw=3 removes the same gate under either tail.
Y5_dissection.runs: grouped folds 0,1 × seed 0 = 4 runs (a screen, D28 semantics), seed-matched to X1 s0 and Y3 s0

hypotheses.H21a: (parent, unchanged) Y3 grouped macro-F1, mean of 6 runs (folds 0,1 × seeds 0,1,2) ≥ 0.5108
hypotheses.H21b: (parent, unchanged) Y3 stratified macro-F1, mean of 3 runs (seeds 0,1,2) ≥ 0.7090
hypotheses.H21c: Superiority on fresh seeds: Y3 grouped mean (seeds 1,2; 4 runs) − X1 grouped mean (same folds/seeds; 0.528496) ≥ +0.020 AND the hierarchical bootstrap 95 % CI of the difference excludes 0
hypotheses.H21d: Session robustness on fresh seeds: Y3 grouped (seeds 1,2) cross-session recall mean ≥ 0.1666 AND cross-session attraction mean ≤ 0.4240 (the H19b/H20 bars)
hypotheses.H21e: Within-acquisition superiority on fresh seeds: Y3 stratified mean (seeds 1,2) − X1 stratified mean (seeds 1,2; 0.728593) ≥ +0.018
hypotheses.H22a: Dissection (screen): Y5 desc_only grouped mean (seed 0, 2 runs) ≥ 0.530786 + 0.020 = 0.5508
hypotheses.H22b: Dissection (screen): Y5 spatial_repair grouped mean (seed 0, 2 runs) ≥ 0.5508

decision_rule.H21a and H21b: the parent's adopt applies: the lean architecture becomes the reference form (SeedNet v5) and the base of every later arm; the config defaults switch to R1 + the lean keys behind G-neutral (D24, D29 deviation 1 closed); the paper drops the index-bank/continuum/derivative claims
decision_rule.not (H21a and H21b): S13's Y3 verdict was a false screening pass: X1's architecture stays the reference; F74 is marked challenged
decision_rule.H21c: the paper may claim the lean network raises grouped macro-F1 over X1 (gate G3 met on fresh seeds); ¬H21c → 'non-inferior; gain not confirmed'
decision_rule.H21d: the paper may claim the lean network raises cross-session recall and lowers attraction; ¬H21d → 'robustness gain not confirmed'
decision_rule.H21e: the within-acquisition gain is confirmed; ¬H21e → not claimed
decision_rule.H22a xor H22b: the passing component carries Y3's gain; the paper attributes it to that component and describes the other as housekeeping
decision_rule.H22a and H22b: either removal alone suffices (non-additive); both are kept, attribution reported as redundant
decision_rule.neither H22: the gain needs both changes (interaction) or Y3 seed 0 was favourable; attribution undetermined — read together with H21c
decision_rule.reading order: H22a/H22b are read as attribution only if H21a and H21b hold; otherwise they are reported descriptively. A dissection pass is a screening verdict (D28) and is not replicated unless a later frozen file needs it
decision_rule.combination: nothing else is combined with Y3 in this round; Y1 and Y2 were screening rejections (S14) and are not replicated

guards: The parent's guards, unchanged (dirty / commit; clip fraction > 0.01 outside epoch 1 and overflow epochs reported; stop epoch < 160 reported)

Code identity: the S15 commit may change only the runner. `git diff aed5257 <S15 commit> -- src/spectralquadnet/models src/spectralquadnet/engine src/spectralquadnet/data src/spectralquadnet/config` must be empty, or G-neutral must pass for the default AND the Y3 keys against aed5257 before any cell runs
Same runtime as S11/S13 (Kaggle T4 × 2, torch 2.10.0+cu128); a different environment is reported, and its cells are compared with X1 only through the seed-0 Y3 cells re-run there

cells.base_overrides: runtime=kaggle_t4x2 tracking=console_jsonl (as S11/S13; torchrun, one directory per cell)
cells.optional: P0.3 re-score of X2/spatial_only__f1_s0 if the S11 notebook output is attached (decides nothing; S13 §8)
cells.runtime_estimate: from the S13 cells' own wall clock on the same runtime (evidence/S14_screen_reading/cells.csv → wall_min): Y3 grouped 25.3 min × 4, Y3 stratified 31.7 × 2, desc_only ≈ X1 grouped 25.7 × 2, spatial_repair ≈ Y3 grouped 25.3 × 2 → ≈ 267 min ≈ 4.4 h (≤ 4.8 h if every cell runs 200 epochs); one Kaggle session

implementation: No model, data or training code. The S13 runner reads one seed for every cell (deviation.seed); S15 needs each cell's own seed (cells.gpu[*].seed) and this file's hash registered — a runner-only change (e.g. experiments/s15.py reusing experiments/s13.py's cell builder), verified by --check/--cfg-job as in S13.
not_in_this_round: Y1/Y2 replication (screening rejections); the lean 80/20 tier (FW-37, after H21a ∧ H21b); X6 level block (D25); the CPU-first track FW-27/FW-28/FW-29 (each needs its own frozen file); RGB morphology FW-18 (needs the raw archive).
heldout_use: Each cell is scored once on val ∪ test. No arm, epoch, threshold or hyperparameter is chosen by a held-out score. S14's post-hoc diagnostics (e.g. the held-out fusion-weight grid) chose nothing and feed nothing here.
